state.evaluationScope: Full Plan45 scenario Browser Mode eligibility reassessment
state.background:
Independently reassess all 123 active logical scenarios against the exact source assertions and full condition in each question. Historical aggregate context is supplied solely to explain prior work and must not determine answers: (1) initial internal classification was 1 eligible / 5 unresolved / 117 not eligible, Emax=6/123=4.9%; (2) first direct choice audit was 27 eligible / 96 not eligible / 0 unresolved; (3) the follow-up reason audit of those 96 chose real_layout_geometry_or_coordinate_hit_test for 63, nextjs_or_production_integration for 7, engine_specific_behavior for 1, and actually_eligible for 25; (4) carrying forward the unreviewed 27 gives provisional 52 eligible / 71 not eligible / 0 unresolved =42.28%. Each prior label/reason is merely a hypothesis to recheck. In particular, the prior 63 geometry tag is NOT itself a product limitation. Strict >50% of A=123 requires at least 62 eligible scenarios; keep all 123 active rows in denominator and do not alter scope/boundaries.

Provider/context facts for this review: the project locks Vitest 4.1.11 but currently has no @vitest/browser or @vitest/browser-playwright/provider and vitest.config.ts uses happy-dom; this is only setup absence, not a product limitation. Vitest Browser Mode runs native browser globals in a test iframe served through Vite; viewport is configurable by browser.viewport and page.viewport. Playwright/WebdriverIO providers use CDP/WebDriver instead of simulated events. Locator click supports cursor position and wheel precise pixel deltas; Playwright locator/page offer boundingBox and coordinate click. Touchscreen tap is possible with hasTouch through provider/custom command (built-in Vitest userEvent has no touch method; Playwright tap is limited). Browser Mode provider instances can include chromium/firefox/webkit. Therefore do NOT label a scenario ineligible merely because it measures real DOM/CSS/SVG/chart geometry or uses viewport, scroll, mouse coordinates, or engine-specific behavior. Evaluate whether the exact assertion is reproducible with provider/browser capabilities.

Do not overcorrect: Browser Mode test content is inside a Vite-served iframe, not the Next production app/route. Contracts requiring Next build/start, Next route/server components, Flight/hydration, URL/query-to-screen route wiring, production download/CSV parity, or the outer top-level/full app shell remain Playwright. Viewport-only styling must be judged from the exact assertion. Each row's history is non-ground-truth metadata; decide anew from its actual test snippets and condition. No code changes or verification runs are in scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Every one of the 123 stable IDs receives exactly one of the nine listed choices.
Choices distinguish four eligible mechanisms, four ineligible blockers, and unresolved evidence/fidelity exactly as defined in each question.
Keep A=123; map categories a-d to eligible, e-h to not eligible, and i to unresolved. Compute MAP counts and separately preserve model probability distributions.
Report whether MAP eligible count and eligible+unresolved upper bound reach 62; do not conflate MAP classification with probability mass.
knownConstraints: Prior classifications are non-ground-truth history only.
Vitest Browser Mode dependencies are currently absent, which is setup work, not capability evidence.
No tests/build, plan update, commit, or push is requested.
state.outputRequirement: Return one structured choice answer keyed by every scenario ID in this request. Use only the listed category; no free-text diagnosis.
